title: Return Reason Points on Restocking
content:
The reason given for returning a line feeds the Returns & Exchanges restocking charge on its grade B units: reason points move the restocking percentage according to the return reason recorded for that line on the return authorization.

## Reason points

| Reason recorded for the line | Reason points |
|---|---|
| Changed mind | Adds 3 percentage points |
| Not as pictured | Takes off 5 percentage points |
| Arrived too late | Takes off 5 percentage points |
| Any other reason (too small, too large, defective, unwanted gift) | None |

The restocking percentage so moved is never below zero.

- The reason read is the one on the line's authorization entry, not a reason the customer gives later.
- Example (hypothetical): with a restocking percentage of 15 percent, a grade B line returned as "changed mind" is charged at 18 percent; the same line returned as "not as pictured", at 10 percent; returned as "too small", at 15 percent.
